Markets slip as rate fears return

By Alex Smith

Global stocks fell on Monday as investors weighed the prospect of higher-for-longer interest rates, with technology shares leading the decline in Europe.

The Stoxx 600 was down 1.2% by midday, while futures on Wall Street pointed to a lower open. Government bond yields rose again.

"The market is repricing the path of policy," said one strategist. "Every data point that comes in strong pushes the first cut further out."
